_comment: Copy this file to model_config.json for non-secret model settings. Put every API key in the project-root .env; api_key_env selects its variable name. Top-level keys are model names (model-key); any key starting with 'embedding' is reserved and never used as the default chat model. See README.md > Configuration.

embedding._comment: OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint (vLLM / SGLang / TEI / OpenAI). This is the DEFAULT embedding entry the engine looks for. Put EMBEDDING_API_KEY=EMPTY in the root .env for a local server that ignores authentication.

embedding_local._comment: Alternative: load embedding weights IN-PROCESS via sentence-transformers (no HTTP server). Select with --embedding-key embedding_local. Install the optional 'sentence-transformers' package and a hardware-compatible 'torch' build separately. 'model' is a HF repo id or a local weights directory.
